LanguageData.RWS_Setting_IncludeDevMode: Show and count endings recorded in development mode
LanguageData.RWS_Setting_AutoImport: Import saves automatically at the title screen
LanguageData.RWS_WindowError: The statistics window failed to draw. See the log for details.
LanguageData.RWS_NoData: Nothing recorded yet. Figures appear once the save import finishes (Import tab).
LanguageData.RWS_TooltipBasis: Computed from {0} colonies ({1} excluded from totals)
LanguageData.RWS_TooltipMissing: {0} saves that could not be identified or read are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_EndingsTooltipPreInstall: Play from before the mod was installed is counted only from traces left in the saves. A trace means "at least once"; Archonexus and other endings cannot be counted from saves.
LanguageData.RWS_ExcludeTip: A checked colony stays in the list but is left out of all totals.
LanguageData.RWS_Import_NotRunThisSession: No import has run in this session yet.
LanguageData.RWS_Import_CorruptRenamed: The damaged file was kept as {0}.
LanguageData.RWS_Import_ReadOnly: Nothing is written to the record file this session.
LanguageData.RWS_Import_SaveError: Could not write the record file: {0}
LanguageData.RWS_Import_Problems: Saves that failed or could not be identified ({0})
LanguageData.RWS_LoadSource_NewerSchema: record file from a newer version (read-only)
LanguageData.RWS_WealthCoverage: Wealth data from {0} colonies ({1} without data).
LanguageData.RWS_Source_RecoveredLineage: Recovered from save (dev mode unknown, excluded from totals)
LanguageData.RWS_Details_ThroughTip: In-game day of the save the value comes from.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_Note: From {0} colonies (excluded from totals: {1}). Values are computed from the imported saves and may include what happened through dev-mode actions.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_Unattributed: {0} observations that could not be matched to one colony are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_Tip_StartGame: Measured from: the start of the game
LanguageData.RWS_Details_Tip_StartSnapshot: The state at the time of saving.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_Tip_Unknown: There is no data to base it on (saves read before this version, a missing file, an unsupported game version, or unreadable data).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthItemsPeak: Largest item wealth in the history graph (one observation per half day). All colonies: the single highest.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthItemsLatest: Item wealth at the last history observation. All colonies: the sum.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthBuildingsPeak: Largest building wealth in the history graph. All colonies: the single highest.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthBuildingsLatest: Building wealth at the last history observation. All colonies: the sum.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthPawnsPeak: Largest wealth in pawns and animals in the history graph. All colonies: the single highest.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthPawnsLatest: Wealth in pawns and animals at the last history observation. All colonies: the sum.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalMean: Mean of the valid total wealth observations. All colonies: weighted by the number of observations.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalFirst: Total wealth at the first observation of a history that is complete from the start. One colony only.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalNet: Total wealth at the last observation minus the first; negative if it fell. All colonies: the sum.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalPeakDay: Nominal day of the first observation at the peak total wealth (one observation per half day). One colony only.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalMaxGainHalfDay: Largest rise of total wealth between two consecutive observations; 0 if it never rose.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalMaxLossHalfDay: Largest fall of total wealth between two consecutive observations; 0 if it never fell.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalMaxLossRateHal: Largest (before − after) ÷ before between two consecutive observations, leaving out intervals that start at 0.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalMaxGain15D: Largest rise of total wealth between observations 30 apart (15 days); periods with a gap are not used.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalMaxLoss15D: Largest fall of total wealth between observations 30 apart (15 days); periods with a gap are not used.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalMaxGrowthRateY: Largest (after − before) ÷ before between observations 120 apart (one year); negative if wealth always fell.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalLongestGrowth: Longest run of observations in which total wealth rose every time; equal values and gaps end a run.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalFirst100K: Nominal day of the first observation with total wealth of 100,000 or more. All colonies: the earliest.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalFirst1M: Nominal day of the first observation with total wealth of 1,000,000 or more. All colonies: the earliest.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthBuildingsMaxShare: Largest building wealth ÷ total wealth at the same observation.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FreeColonistsMean: Mean of the observed number of free colonists. All colonies: weighted by the number of observations.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FreeColonistsMin: Smallest observed number of free colonists. All colonies: the smallest.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FreeColonistsFirst10: Nominal day of the first observation with 10 or more free colonists. All colonies: the earliest.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_PrisonersMean: Mean of the observed number of prisoners. All colonies: weighted by the number of observations.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MoodMean: Mean of the observed average colonist mood (0–100). A 0, recorded when there are no colonists, is treated as missing. Not weighted by colonist count.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MoodMin: Lowest valid observation of the average colonist mood.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MoodMax: Highest valid observation of the average colonist mood.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MoodBelow50Days: Half-day intervals with both ends valid whose starting mood is below 50, ÷ 2. All colonies: the sum.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_MoodAtLeast80Days: Days with mood at 80% or more (observed)
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MoodAtLeast80Days: Half-day intervals with both ends valid whose starting mood is 80 or more, ÷ 2. All colonies: the sum.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_DeathsPerYear: Colonist deaths ÷ elapsed years (1 year = 60 days) in the same save. All colonies: total deaths ÷ total years.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidsPerYear: Enemy raids ÷ elapsed years (1 year = 60 days) in the same save. All colonies: total raids ÷ total years.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ModsLatest: Active mods listed in the latest save, including Core and DLCs. One colony only.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ModsPeak: Most mods in any imported save of this colony. One colony only.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ModsMin: Fewest mods in any imported save of this colony. One colony only.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestSuccess: Accepted quests that succeeded and are still in the save. Quests the game removed cannot be counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestFailure: Accepted quests that failed and are still in the save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestSuccessRate: Successes ÷ (successes + failures). All colonies: the summed numerators ÷ the summed denominators.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestSuccessByRoot: Succeeded quests by quest type (def name). Click to show the breakdown.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestExpired: Quest offers still in the save that expired without being accepted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestAccepted: Quests still in the save that were accepted (including automatically), ongoing ones included.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_QuestSuccessDurationMean: Mean days of succeeded quests (acceptance to cleanup)
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestSuccessDurationMean: Mean days from acceptance to the start of cleanup for succeeded quests; quests without an acceptance time are left out.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestSuccessDurationMin: Fewest days in the same sample as the mean.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestSuccessDurationMax: Most days in the same sample as the mean.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankByDifficultyDays: Colony days summed by the difficulty of each colony's furthest point; changes of difficulty during play are not tracked. Click to show the breakdown.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankByDifficultyEndings: Endings counted as on the Overview (dev-mode setting, traces as at least once), by the difficulty of each colony's furthest point.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankByPermadeathDays: Colony days summed by whether each colony's furthest point is in permadeath mode.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankByPermadeathEndings: Endings counted as on the Overview, by whether each colony's furthest point is in permadeath mode.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankPopulationPeak: The highest of the game's greatest-population counters across colonies, and its colony.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankFastestEnding: The ending recorded during play with the fewest in-game days, and its colony. Pre-install traces, whose time is unknown, are left out.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankNetWealthPerYear: The colonies' net wealth changes summed, ÷ the years their histories span, summed (histories of one observation are left out).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankTopScenario: The most endings for one scenario name of the colonies' furthest points, and the name; ties are listed together. Click to show the breakdown.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankDaysByStoryteller: Colony days summed by the storyteller of each colony's furthest point.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_RankPlaytimePeak: Colony with the most play time
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankPlaytimePeak: The longest real play time of one colony, and the colony.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankWealthPerColonist: Largest total wealth ÷ free colonists (at least one) at the same observation, and its colony; only where both histories are complete from the start.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankMinDeathsAtEnding: The fewest colonist deaths at the moment an ending was recorded, and the colony. Endings recorded before this version have no death count and are left out.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankZeroDeathEndings: Endings whose colonist death count was 0 when recorded. Endings without a death count are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ResearchLiveCompleted: Research projects that went from unfinished to finished since recording began, each counted once. Not the number of projects finished at save time.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ResearchLiveCompletedTick: Per project completed while recorded, the game day it was first finished. Shown per colony only.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ResearchLiveDurationMin: Fewest days from the first real work on a project to its completion, including pauses. Projects whose start was not seen are left out.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ResearchLiveDurationMax: Most days in the same sample as the shortest.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_ResearchLiveFirstDay: Days to the first research completion
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ResearchLiveFirstDay: The game day of the first completion, only when recorded from the start of the game.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MentalBreaks: Mood-caused mental breaks of free colonists. Breaks from drugs, genes, psycasts or dev tools are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MentalBreaksByDef: The mental breaks above, by type (MentalBreakDef).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Inspirations: Inspirations that really started for free colonists. Failed attempts, already-inspired pawns and dev tools are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_HostileKills: Deaths of pawns hostile to the player just before dying, whose cause the damage record attributes to the player's side (colonists, turrets, traps, animals, mechs). Deaths without a known attribution are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_KillsPerPawnMax: The most kills credited to one player pawn; the breakdown names the holder (by id). Kills known only by their cause are not credited to anyone.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_KillsByVictimKind: Enemy kills split into humanlike, insect, mechanoid and other.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RangedKills: Enemy kills made with ranged weapons (explosions count as explosive).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MeleeKills: Enemy kills made with an equipped melee weapon.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_UnarmedKills: Enemy kills made with melee attacks without a weapon.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ExplosiveKills: Enemy kills whose killing damage was an explosion.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_EnvironmentKills: Enemy kills by fire or other environmental damage that the record attributes to the player's side. Natural deaths and unattributed ones are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TurretKills: Enemy kills whose attacker was a player turret.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TrapKills: Enemy kills caused by a player trap.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TameAnimalKills: Enemy kills whose attacker was a player animal.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_PlayerMechKills: Enemy kills whose attacker was a player mechanoid (Biotech).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_DeathCauses: Free colonist deaths by the culprit health condition (hediff) or the killing damage type. Deaths with neither are "unknown".
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_DeathsByRaid: Free colonist deaths split into those caused by a raider, other known causes, and unknown. While raids are not recorded, they are unknown.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_DiseaseDeaths: Free colonist deaths whose culprit was a sickness (a condition the game treats as making the pawn sick). Deaths merely accompanied by a disease are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_DiseaseDeathRate: Deaths from disease ÷ free colonist deaths with a known cause.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_LongestDeathGap: Longest time without a colonist death
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_LongestDeathGap: The longest interval between two consecutive free colonist deaths while recorded. The time before the first and after the last death is not an interval.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_FirstDeathDay: Days to the first colonist death
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FirstDeathDay: The game day of the first free colonist death, only when recorded from the start of the game.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OldestDeathAge: The highest biological age of a free colonist just before dying. The same value as the longest-lived colonist (P-010).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CaravanMemberDeaths: Free colonists who died while in a player caravan.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ColonyAnimalDeaths: Deaths of animals that belonged to the player just before dying.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ColonyAnimalRaidDeaths: Colony animal deaths whose attacker belonged to a tracked raid.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ColonistsDowned: Times a free colonist went from not downed to downed. Instant deaths without a downing are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_EnemiesDowned: Times a pawn hostile to the player went down; going down again after recovering is another time. The same value as enemies incapacitated (B-002).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ToxicDowns: Free colonist downs directly caused by toxic buildup (Biotech).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_SocialFightDowns: Free colonist downs caused directly by the opponent of a social fight.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidsByArrivalMode: Successful enemy raids by arrival mode (PawnsArrivalModeDef). The total is the number of raids.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidsByFaction: Successful enemy raids by the attacking faction's def.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidPawnsMax: The most enemy pawns generated for one successful raid. Raid points are a separate row.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidPointsMax: The highest final raid points used to generate a successful raid.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidKillsMax: The most kills the player's side made among one tracked raid's pawns while that raid lasted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidBreaches: Raids with a breaching strategy (ImmediateAttackBreaching, ImmediateAttackBreachingSmart). Sappers are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidDrops: Raids arriving by drop pod (EdgeDrop, EdgeDropGroups, CenterDrop, RandomDrop).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Infestations: Successful insect hive infestations (Infestation, DeepDrillInfestation). Other insect-related events are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MechClusters: Successful mech cluster incidents (Royalty). Ordinary mechanoid raids are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidLongestGap: The longest interval between two consecutive raids while recorded, not counting before the first or after the last. The same value as the largest raid interval (N2-C-002).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidMeanGap: The mean of the same intervals; overall, weighted by the number of intervals.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidFirstDay: The game day of the first raid, only when recorded from the start of the game.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidsRetreated: Tracked raids that ended with some enemies leaving the map alive.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidsWiped: Tracked raids that ended with every enemy killed and none retreating. A raid with prisoners has another outcome.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidRepelledRate: Raids that retreated or were wiped out ÷ tracked raids with a decided outcome. Raids whose outcome is unknown (e.g. the map vanished) are left out.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_RaidRepelledNoDown: Raids repelled without a colonist down
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidRepelledNoDown: Repelled raids during which no free colonist went down on the same map.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidDurationMean: The mean days from arrival until the last tracked enemy was out of the fight, over raids with a decided outcome.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidDurationMax: The most days in the same sample.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidDurationMinRepelled: The fewest days of a raid that retreated or was wiped out.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FirstJoins: Pawns who became free colonists for the first time, other than the starting colonists and births. Each pawn counts once.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_JoinRoutes: New members split into recruited prisoners, emancipated slaves and other routes.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_PrisonerRecruits: Pawns who were prisoners of the colony and joined for the first time by recruitment.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_HumanBirths: Humanlike children born alive on the player's side (Biotech). Stillbirths are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_UniqueMembers: Pawns who were colonists while recorded (starting colonists, new members, births). Rejoining adds nothing. Overall, the sum over colonies.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Rejoins: Pawns who explicitly left and later became free colonists again.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_JoinAgeMean: The mean biological age of new members when they joined.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_FirstJoinDay: Days to the first new member
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FirstJoinDay: The game day of the first new member, only when recorded from the start of the game.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_SlavesFreed: Slaves whose slave status was lifted (emancipated). Not the same as releasing prisoners.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RecruitTimeMin: The fewest days from becoming a prisoner of the colony to joining by recruitment, where both were observed.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RecruitTimeMax: The most days in the same sample.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Kidnaps: Times a free colonist was kidnapped into a faction's captives.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_KidnapRescues: Kidnapped colonists who came back through a confirmed route (ransom). Other routes are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CaptiveMax: The longest captivity from kidnapping to return that was tracked.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_LifeMean: The mean biological age of free colonists at death. Living colonists are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TenureMean: The mean days from joining (or the start of the game) to death or leaving, where both ends were tracked. Ongoing stays are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FirstSkill20: (Pawn, skill) pairs of free colonists that first reached 20 through learning while recorded. Dropping and reaching 20 again counts once.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_JoinGainPeak: The largest increase of a skill over its level at joining. Pawns whose level at joining is not known are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Marriages: Pairs that became spouses; both sides' notifications count as one.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Divorces: Spouse relations ended by divorce. Bereavement and other relation removals are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Lovers: Pairs that became lovers; both sides' notifications count as one.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_SocialFights: Social fights started; two pawns make one fight.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_PrisonBreaks: Prison breaks started, however many prisoners escaped.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_PrisonersReleased: Prisoners of the colony whose release completed. Escapes are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_PrisonersCaptured: Hostile pawns captured into prisoners of the colony.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnimalBonds: Bonds formed between a colonist and a colony animal.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnimalsTamed: Wild animals that became the player's through successful taming. Purchases are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnimalBirths: Player animals born or hatched alive. Separate from humanlike births.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnimalsSlaughtered: Colony animal deaths by designated slaughter.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnimalsHunted: Wild animals designated for hunting and killed by a player pawn. Incidental fights are not counted.
